# teams app rsc

Manage RSC (Resource-Specific Consent) permissions

## Usage

```
teams app rsc
```
<!-- AUTOGENERATED:END -->

## Interactive permissions

The app's **Permissions (RSC)** menu offers Team, Chat, and User permissions from a bundled catalog. Chat application permissions include meeting property access (`OnlineMeeting.Read.Chat`, `OnlineMeeting.ReadWrite.Chat`), meeting artifacts (`OnlineMeetingArtifact.Read.Chat`), and virtual event access (`VirtualEvent.Read.Chat`, `VirtualEventRegistration-Anon.ReadWrite.Chat`).

Catalog entries are available choices, not default grants. New apps request no RSC permissions automatically. Permission availability can depend on the tenant and service configuration; appearing in the catalog does not guarantee that Teams Developer Portal will accept a permission.
